mapper.sql: MENU_ID AS id, MENU_CODE AS menuCode, MENU_NAME AS menuName, PARENT_MENU_ID AS parentMenuId, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, ENABLED AS enabled, CREATED_BY AS createdBy, CREATED_AT AS createdAt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ADMIN_MENU
UPPER(MENU_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{nameKeyword}) || '%'
ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, MENU_ID
SELECT FROM ADMIN_MENU WHERE PARENT_MENU_ID = #{parentMenuId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, MENU_ID

SELECT menu.MENU_ID AS id, menu.MENU_CODE AS menuCode, menu.MENU_NAME AS menuName, menu.PARENT_MENU_ID AS parentMenuId, menu.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, menu.ENABLED AS enabled, menu.CREATED_BY AS createdBy, menu.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ADMIN_MENU menu JOIN ADMIN_ROLE_MENU role_menu ON role_menu.MENU_ID = menu.MENU_ID WHERE role_menu.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY menu.SORT_ORDER, menu.MENU_ID
